## Use Sometype Mono in VS Code

Paste this into your settings to set Sometype Mono for the editor. The fallbacks are the same ones CodeFont writes.

{
  "editor.fontFamily": "'Sometype Mono', 'JetBrains Mono', 'SF Mono', Monaco, 'Cascadia Code', 'Roboto Mono', monospace"
}

## About the Sometype Mono coding font

A modern paid programming font. Sometype Mono is a paid monospace coding font without programming ligatures.

Sometype Mono is not hosted on Google Fonts. The specimen above renders in the real face when the font is installed on your device; if it is not installed, the page falls back to a standard monospace face so the layout stays intact. It is one of the 95 families in the CodeFont catalog.

## Sometype Mono FAQ

### Is Sometype Mono free?

No. Sometype Mono is a commercial font, sold by its vendor.

### Does Sometype Mono support ligatures?

No. Sometype Mono has no programming ligatures, so sequences such as -> and != are drawn as separate characters.

### Where can I get Sometype Mono?

Sometype Mono is available from Official Website. The download links are listed in the Where to get section above.
